title: Rondo Legacies: Rondo's Promising Future
description: Join Benny Roberts, Mercedes Yarbrough, and Mikeya Griffin to learn what motivates them, what challenges they face, and their hopes for Rondo’s future. These young leaders of Rondo will reflect on their roles in community building, the legacy they’re carrying forward, and how community members can get involved.
